title: g_tls_safe_mode is global: affects all uses of the devId, not just TLS contexts
description: g_tls_safe_mode is a process-global flag. Once wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid*() is called, ALL hash operations via WOLF_CRYPTO2DEV_DEVID fall back to software, even those in non-TLS wolfcrypt contexts. If a caller registers the device manually (wc_CryptoCb_RegisterDevice) for standalone hash acceleration, and then later calls wc_crypto2dev_assign_devid for a TLS CTX, hardware hash is silently disabled for both. Scenario: caller wants hardware hash for bulk data plus hardware cipher/HMAC for TLS. After assign_devid for TLS, the standalone hash starts falling back to software with no error, just a silent performance regression. Maintenance consequence: impossible to use hardware hash and TLS acceleration simultaneously, and the reason is non-obvious.
